context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-Photo Item Grouping fully tested. Key features: (1) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/merge-items - merges 2+ items into 1, combines images, removes secondary items, updates batch item_count, adds merged_from field. (2) POST /api/field-listing/items/{item_id}/split - splits multi-image item back into separate items, updates batch item_count, adds split_from field. (3) POST /api/field-listing/batches/{batch_id}/suggest-groups - returns suggested groupings based on product_type and color similarity. Frontend: Bulk actions bar shows 'Merge into 1 Item' when 2+ items selected. Merged items show count badge and multi-thumbnail display. Split button visible in expanded detail. Suggest Groups button shows purple banner with potential matches, Merge/Dismiss buttons.

merge_items.behavior: Combines all images under primary item, deletes secondary items, updates batch item_count

split_item.behavior: Keeps first image on original, creates new items for remaining images, updates batch item_count

suggest_groups.behavior: Analyzes items by product_type and color similarity, returns conservative suggestions

frontend_ui.merge_button: data-testid='merge-btn' - appears in bulk actions bar when 2+ items selected
frontend_ui.split_button: data-testid='split-{item_id}' - appears in expanded detail of multi-image items
frontend_ui.suggest_groups_button: data-testid='suggest-groups-btn' - purple button in action bar
frontend_ui.suggested_groups_banner: data-testid='suggested-groups' - purple banner with thumbnails, Merge/Dismiss buttons
frontend_ui.multi_thumbnail_display: Merged items show stacked images with count badge

mocked_api.note: All APIs are real. Vision AI analysis not tested (expensive), but suggest-groups works with items that have vision_analysis set.
